##############################################################################
# AutomationTools - BACKEND (region-breakaway tag pool). GENERATED by
# scratchpad/gen_pool.sh - do not hand-edit; re-run the generator to change it.
#
# atools_pool_select : scan for ONE nation that still holds an EXCLAVE province
#   (is_overseas = yes, i.e. no land route to its capital), save it + a seed
#   province (which fixes the target REGION), set atools_breakaway_pending.
#   First match wins (flag stops the scan).
#
# atools_pool_spawn_effect : recycle dead pool tags, then for each free tag run
#   a select and, if a target was found, core that nation's EXCLAVE provinces in
#   the seed's region and release the tag as a new independent nation. Grouped by
#   region so separate exclave blocks become SEPARATE nations. Stops early once a
#   select finds nothing (atools_pool_exhausted). Contiguous land is never touched.
##############################################################################

atools_pool_select = {
	clr_global_flag = atools_breakaway_pending
	every_country = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = atools_breakaway_pending } num_of_cities = 1 }
		save_event_target_as = atools_split_nation
		if = {
			limit = { any_owned_province = { is_city = yes is_overseas = yes } }
			random_owned_province = {
				limit = { is_city = yes is_overseas = yes }
				save_event_target_as = atools_split_seedprov
			}
			set_global_flag = atools_breakaway_pending
		}
	}
}

		limit = { NOT = { has_global_flag = atools_pool_BV3_used } NOT = { has_global_flag = atools_pool_exhausted } }

			limit = { has_global_flag = atools_breakaway_pending }

				every_owned_province = { limit = { is_city = yes is_overseas = yes region = event_target:atools_split_seedprov } add_core = BV3 }
				release = BV3
			}
			BV3 = {
				change_government = monarchy
				add_government_reform = autocracy_reform
				set_capital = event_target:atools_split_seedprov

		}
		else = { set_global_flag = atools_pool_exhausted }
